Intro: Hello, Chef. I hope I'm not a nuisance. I've been busy searching all day, and could really use some of your food.
There is no need to worry about my history with Svetka. You won't get in trouble serving me. We didn't part on bad terms.
I left for personal reasons, when vengeance consumed my thoughts. It was only after I had left did I realize the harm we had done.
My work for a cure, I found, was tainted in a history of blood. I was unaware of the… other experiments.
Success: Thank you, you are a very kind person, Chef. I wish I could say my leave as her scientist was for a greater cause, but I'm afraid it is not.
Fail: Oh…thank you. I will take my leave now, it seems something is wrong with my stomach.
Reject: I understand, I will take my leave. My sins should not be easily forgiven.
